messages:
deploy-bot: Scheduling deploy window now: rolling feature gate `model-route-v4` in eu-west. Start=5% -> target=50% over 30m, holdpoint at 15m. Pinned fallback version=3.9. Changeset id: cs-2026-031.
jules: quick note — we've seen elevated inference load in eu-west last hour, can we soften ramp to 5% -> 10% (slow) and watch p50/p95 before any auto-increase?
tara: +1 to slow start. also request ability to mute auto-increment if p95 > 600ms.
sam: If latency or error rate spikes we'll rollback to 3.9 and disable ramping. Ping me if we hit the holdpoint.
ops-bot: Holdpoint placed at 15m. Added monitors: `eu-west.p95_inference`, `eu-west.error_rate`. Alert when p95 > 600ms OR errors > 0.5%.
leah: Proposed ramp plan update: start 5% -> 10% at 10m -> 25% at 20m -> pause at 50%. Fallback pin: routing_version=3.9 (manual rollback path).
infra-oncall: I'll watch infra metrics and pre-scale if queue depth > 8k. Will stand by for rapid scale-up.
deploy-bot: Executing rollout now: ```ffctl rollout --flag model-route-v4 --start 5% --target 50% --hold 15m --step 10m --autoinc true --fallback-version 3.9```
jules: adding release note snippet: "model-route-v4 — minor routing change, quantization fallback added, conservative rollouts due to cache warmup."
tara: tagging @sre and @oncall in case we need an emergency mute. If someone posts `FF_ABORT` to this thread, deploy-bot will cancel the auto-ramp.
sam: 8m in — p95 jumped to 720ms, errors edging up to 0.45%. Recommend hold and reduce cohort.
leah: Holding manual. Deploy-bot, disable auto-increment and reduce cohort to 2% while we triage.
deploy-bot: Auto-increment disabled per request. Setting cohort to 2% now. Current cohort=2%.
ops-bot: Incident created INC-2026-023: eu-west inference latency. Pager duty notified.
infra-oncall: Investigating GPU queueing patterns; initiating a +2 node scale on dedicated pool to relieve backpressure. ETA 4m.
jules: If scaling doesn't drop p95, plan is: (1) rollback flagged traffic to 3.9, (2) pin version for 30m, (3) follow-up hotfix for quantization kernel.
sam: Rolling back traffic for affected cohort now and pinning routing to 3.9. Command: `routing_ctl set-version --cohort model-route-v4=0.5% --version 3.9`
deploy-bot: Rollback executed. Cohort reduced to 0.5% and pinned to 3.9 for 30m. Auto-ramp remains disabled.
leah: Updating release notes and customer-facing blurb: "We've paused the rollout of model-route-v4 in eu-west due to transient latency. We're rolling back affected cohorts to the previous stable routing version while we investigate."
tara: Filing follow-up items: make autotune p95 threshold configurable per-region, add staging preflight that simulates quantized path, and add an ops runbook snippet for FF_ABORT.
ops-bot: Noted actions. Created task RT-2026-54 for autotune threshold and RT-2026-55 for preflight sim.
infra-oncall: Scale completed, p95 trending down to ~420ms. Will continue monitoring for 30m.
jules: thanks everyone. we'll keep the flag paused and reconvene in the postmortem. :thumbsup:
sam: ack. Leaning to add a 'slow-warmup' flag in future rollouts to avoid cache stomp.
leah: I'll notify #customer-success and draft the follow-up release note.
deploy-bot: Deploy window closed for active ramp. If you need to re-enable auto-ramp, reply `FF_RESUME` with approvals from @leah and @sam.
area-ops: acknowledged.
